title: Totals over a filtered set in products · part 4

steps.title: COUNT of * where price > 21.39
steps.prompt:
A WHERE filter can narrow a total.
SQL filters the rows first, then count runs on what is left.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE price > 21.39;
hints: Write: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE price > 21.39;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE price > 21.39;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE first, then the total - the filter still counts.
